ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The whole body has no image or shadow presents a body that leaves no visible duplicate or trace.
EvidenceBody: Shushan gives the line to Dongshan in two transmissions; an unnamed monk answers Chaozong with it, and Jifei and the other retained speakers preserve the same traceless-body image.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Shushan’s departure line joins complete bodily presence to the absence of any image that could be tracked or grasped.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The line describes full manifestation without a graspable form or trace.

ComparedThings: the whole body has no image or shadow
the retained dialogue, sermon, verse, and appraisal uses
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Direct dialogue, Hongzhi’s hall line, and later answers all keep 通身 together with 無影像 as one paradox of manifest tracelessness.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The alias renders 通身 as the whole body rather than an anatomical list.

ModifierControls.Finding: The totalizing modifier prevents 影像 from referring to one partial feature.

FamilyControls.Finding: Ordinary shadowlessness is excluded unless the full body-and-image formula is present.
